item.title: RTC looks to federal, state government to fill rail funding gap
item.description: The Santa Cruz County Regional Transportation Commission (RTC) will seek funding from the state and federal government to support construction planning for a passenger rail line spanning the length of the county. In a Thursday meeting, the commission voted unanimously to request $15 million to pay for an environmental impact report on the rail proposal. […]
